title: Lixity — local manuscript analysis and research workbench for authors
description: Lixity is a local workbench for authors, with a browser app, CLI and Python API. Deterministic manuscript analysis covers sentence rhythm, lexical diversity, language-calibrated readability, dialogue, paragraph-level tense and self-calibrating style references with robust statistics. Exact passages connect to retained sources, claims and revisioned research dossiers. PDF and static reading-website exports make explicitly selected material shareable; read-only project inspection distinguishes sources and outputs without moving files or asserting output freshness. The analysis engine runs offline in pure Python. Statistical signals support human review, not literary-quality scores; archive integrity does not establish factual truth.
notes: Deposited from a tagged GitHub release of the software.
